limitations: Existing source flags are retained per heading; homebrew and playtest groups are not missing official features.
Choice and spell-table links require exact title, current/ancestor section anchor and captured page identity; ambiguous matches remain unclassified.
Headings, proposed units and choice options overlap conceptually and are not additive canonical counts.
Unclassified headings can be prose, tables or existing choices; they are not proven missing features.
Legacy pending-component labels are preserved as historical leads, not proof that later metadata work is absent.
Explicit source decisions cover only their twelve recorded section headings; this report does not silently inherit exclusions to child features.
No runtime features, full rules, automation, publication completeness or text rights are accepted.
